messages.author: c4390b997ff96dbb
messages.subject: pull genotypes for selected markers
parts:
hi, I want to look at the genotypes of some SNPS on a linkage group.

I am able to pull genotypes for a single marker using

> g <- pull.geno(All_q50C50)[, "sc3_21_1319488"]

I’d like to pull multiple SNPS (~10-30) at once and have the ouput as a table

thanks, roberta

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] pull genotypes for selected markers
parts:
g <- pull.geno(All_q50C50) shows you all of the marker genotypes as a big matrix.

You can subset that numerically, e.g. for columns 11-20:

g[,11:20]

karl
